video.title: FULLTANK SATURDAY: God Has a Better Version of Your Dream
video.description:
It hurts when our plans fall apart and things don’t turn out the way we hoped. But letting go of our rigid expectations doesn't mean giving up on happiness—it often means trusting that God is clearing the way for a much better version of our dream. When you finally surrender your plans and open your hands, you might just find that His plot twist is infinitely better than anything you could have written for yourself.

#FULLTANKwithBroBo #FULLTANKwithBroBo2026 #BoSanchez #GodHasABetterPlan #SurrenderYourDreams #LetGoAndLetGod #FaithInAction #SpiritualMaturity #TrulyRichMindset #TrustHisTiming #Grace

---
PS. Are You A Parent?
Are you thinking about Homeschooling for your kids?
My wife and I have homeschooled our two boys.
Looking back, it’s one of the BEST decisions we’ve ever made.
It gave us the space to pass on our values.
It also gave them space to explore their passions and interests.
If you want to know more about homeschooling and to find out if it is for your kids, check out this link: www.facebook.com/CFAHomeschool or cfa.edu.ph
